messages:
Anya: thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands, threading a few ops questions that came up. I'll answer what I can, tag people as needed.
Sam: quick Q from eng — is there a commute / coworking stipend for people who need to work from a coworking space during next month's team offsite?
Anya: short answer: yes, there's a temporary coworking allowance for offsite weeks. Up to $40/day with receipts. Please use the expense form and tag your manager. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: do we need pre-approval for that or just submit after?
Anya: prefer pre-approval if it's >$200 total — manager signoff plus People Ops. For under $200 you can submit after with receipts.
Maria: where's the form? I couldn't find it in handbook.
OpsBot: expense form (canonical): https://redwood.example/internal/expenses — category: "Workspace / Offsite". (OpsBot note: make sure to include expense code OFFSITE-2026 in the form.)
Elliot: about travel bookings for multi-site offsites: who should book — individual or people-ops? Any preferred vendors?
Anya: for team-led local hubs (<=20 people) book individually and submit for reimbursement. For company-funded or cross-region offsites ops will coordinate travel and preferred vendor list. We'll post the vendor list this week.
Sam: and approvals for airfare/hotels? Manager ok or do we need Ops pre-approval?
Anya: managers approve airfare under $1000. Anything expected to exceed that or unusual routing — loop in People Ops for pre-approval.
Jordan: hybrid attendance question — leadership mentioned quarterly in-persons. Is that mandatory for everyone?
Maria: leadership clarification from the roadmap Q/A: quarterly all-hands in person is strongly encouraged; for core product milestones we expect team leads to ask for a presence window, but accommodations are available for extenuating circumstances.
Elliot: can we expect stipend for temporary coworking if our home setup is unusable (repairs, etc.)?
Anya: yes, you can request a temporary home-office stipend for repairs or short-term coworking. Submit with receipts and a short note. Ops will triage within 5 business days.
Sam: what's the desk booking policy in the San Francisco office? Hot desk only or assigned?
Anya: hybrid desks: the new floor is hot-desk with a small pool of reservable collaboration rooms. Team-assigned desks only for dedicated headcount requests (apply via the facilities form).
Jordan: will we get clarification on expense codes? I accidentally used the wrong one last month.
OpsBot: approved expense codes: WORKSPACE, OFFSITE-2026, TRAVEL-2026. If mismatched, Ops will reach out for correction.
Maria: can we please get a short doc that summarizes all this (quick: coworking allowance, approvals, booking flow, desk policy)? I can help draft and publish to handbook.
Anya: yes please — Maria if you can draft a 1-pager I'll review and Ops will publish.
Sam: thanks — one more: for managers that want to plan small cross-site meetups, is there a budget template?
Anya: use the team offsite checklist (snippet):
```
Team offsite checklist:
- Estimated headcount and dates
- Budget estimate (travel + lodging + meals + coworking)
- Desired venue and vendor list
- Accessibility / dietary needs
- Manager + Ops approval before bookings
```
Anya: drop the draft here when ready and we'll pin the final doc to the #people-ops channel.
Maria: will do, aiming to post draft by Friday.
Elliot: thanks — this cleared up most questions. :thumbsup:
Anya: awesome — feel free to DM for edge cases. I'll update handbook after Maria's draft and ping leadership clarifications if needed.
OpsBot: reminder: submissions for OFFSITE-2026 reimbursements should include receipts and the expense code. Processing ETA: 7-10 business days.
